plans.name: Free
plans.description: Intelligence for everyday tasks. Limited access to GPT-5.6 Luna. Unlimited text chats subject to abuse guardrails. Limited messages with uploads. Limited and slower image generation. Limited voice chats. Limited deep research. Limited memory and context. Limited Codex access. Limited ChatGPT Work access on desktop. Can use GPTs made by others. Access on web, iOS, Android.

plans.name: Go
plans.description: Expanded access. Everything in Free and: More messages with tools. More uploads. More image creation. More voice chats. Longer memory. May include ads.

plans.name: Plus
plans.description: Do more with advanced intelligence. Everything in Go and: Advanced reasoning models with GPT-5.6. Expanded messages and uploads. More complex and accurate image creation. Expanded deep research. Expanded memory and context. Projects, scheduled tasks, and custom GPTs. Expanded Codex usage. Expanded access to ChatGPT Work on desktop, web, and mobile. Early access to new features. Limits apply.

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro ($100/mo)
plans.description: Maximize productivity. Includes full GPT-5.6 family, 5x Plus usage limits, stronger GPT-5.6 access, GPT-5.4, o3-pro, and Codex.

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro ($200/mo)
plans.description: Highest self-serve individual usage tier. Includes full GPT-5.6 family, 20x Plus usage limits, 250 deep research runs/month, unlimited Sora video, o4-mini, advanced voice mode, extended context, Operator agent.

plans.name: Business
plans.description: AI solutions for businesses. Centralized billing and administration, usage analytics, budgeting, spend controls, secure workspace with SAML SSO and MFA, no training on business data by default.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: AI solutions for large enterprises. Custom pricing, enhanced security, and dedicated support. Includes enterprise-grade features for operating at scale.

plans.name: ChatGPT for Teachers
plans.description: 米国のK-12教育者向けに、2027年6月まで提供される無料プラン。

plans.name: ChatGPT Edu
plans.description: Advanced capabilities for universities with specialized pricing. Helps educational institutions deploy AI safely and effectively across campuses.

plans.name: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
plans.description: Offers eligible faculty and postdoctoral researchers 12 months of complimentary access to a dedicated ChatGPT workspace. Approved teams can include up to five verified researchers from the same institution and receive business data protections and ChatGPT Pro-level usage limits. Participants can use GPT-5.6 across ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex for research and coding workflows.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Maximize your productivity. Everything in Plus and: 5x or 20x more usage. Pro reasoning with GPT-5.6 Sol Pro. Maximum Codex tasks. Unlimited and faster image creation. Maximum deep research. Maximum memory and context. Expanded projects, tasks, and custom GPTs. Research preview of new features.

plans.name: Edu
plans.description: 大学がAIを学生、教員、研究者、キャンパス運営に責任を持って展開するために構築されたChatGPTのバージョンです。GPT-4oを搭載し、テキストとビジョン全体で推論し、データ分析、Webブラウジング、ドキュメント要約などの高度なツールを使用できます。エンタープライズレベルのセキュリティとコントロールが含まれ、教育機関にとって手頃な価格です。会話とデータはOpenAIモデルのトレーニングには使用されません。

plans.name: Free Plan
plans.description: For beginners and individuals to explore AI without paying. Limited access to GPT-5.6 Luna. Unlimited text chats. Limited images per day with DALL-E. File uploads with restrictions. Web browsing capabilities. No access to advanced voice mode or custom GPTs.

plans.name: ChatGPT Go
plans.description: Unlimited GPT-5.6 Luna access with ads (in US). Includes unlimited text chats.

plans.name: ChatGPT Plus
plans.description: For power users. Extended limits and access during peak times. Access to GPT-5.6 Sol, Sora video, Codex, Agent Mode, Deep Research. Ad-free. Use voice mode with video and screensharing. Create custom GPTs.

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro ($100/month tier)
plans.description: For heavy personal use. Includes GPT-5.5 Pro and ~5x Plus limits. Access to Sol Pro.

plans.name: ChatGPT Pro ($200/month tier)
plans.description: For power-user workflows. Includes ~20x Plus limits and 1M context window, 250 Deep Research runs. Unlimited ChatGPT Voice. Access to Sol Pro.

plans.name: ChatGPT Business
plans.description: For small to mid-sized teams. Includes unlimited GPT-5.5, shared workspace, admin console with SAML SSO, SOC 2 Type 2 compliance, and 60+ data connectors. Business data is not used for model training.

plans.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
plans.description: For large organizations with custom pricing. Includes advanced features and higher usage limits.
